    Why This Program Costs Less

    Paid Media Charges You to Find Every Shopper

    On Google and Meta, you bid in an auction for the chance to reach people who might be shopping, and you pay for every click or lead. Intent data starts with people who already searched for what you sell. Here’s what retailers typically pay through ads for one interested shopper.

    Google Search Ads

    $97.51
    per conversion for apparel, fashion and jewelry retailers. Each click costs $4.44, and only about 4 or 5 in every 100 clicks become a conversion.

    You pay for every click, even when it’s someone browsing for fun or tapping by accident. Your real monthly cost also includes ad design and agency fees for account management, which are not included in the cost below.

    $48,750This is what you would need to spend to get 500 conversions.That’s about 170,000 ad views and 11,000 clicks, before agency fees. A conversion is a sign-up or inquiry, not a guaranteed sale.

    Facebook & Instagram

    $27.66
    per conversion on Meta lead ads, meaning someone who taps your ad and fills out a short form. Views cost $8 to $20 per 1,000, and more in Q4.

    Ads target interests, not recent searches, so many views go to people who aren’t shopping. Your real monthly cost also includes ad design and agency fees for account management, which are not included in the cost below.

    $13,830This is what you would need to spend to get 500 conversions.That’s about 300,000 ad views and 6,500 clicks, before agency fees. A conversion is a lead form, not a guaranteed sale.

Reach estimates use the same reports’ median click-through and conversion rates (Google: 6.64% of views clicked, 4.5% of clicks convert for apparel; Meta: 2.19% clicked, 7.72% of lead ad clicks convert). Your own costs will vary.

    One to One, Every Day

    Cold Email Sequences

    A short, personal note from Erin, sent to people who searched in the last 24 hours. If they don’t reply, a follow up goes out a few days later. Two ways to play it: get a reply for an online sale, or get them through your door.

      We Never Mention the Search, or How We Got Their Contact Info. Every message reads like a local store reaching out. Anyone can reply “no” to be taken off the list.

      We Never Send Emails From Your Live Domain. Here’s Why.Outreach email runs on its own setup. We buy a pool of separate domains and inboxes that use variations of your name, so blantonsbootandhat.com and your own email are never touched. Your brand and your inbox reputation stay protected.

      Sample sending domains:blantonsbootco.comshopblantons.comblantonswestern.comblantonsboots.co

      Before anything goes out, we warm up each new inbox over a few weeks, sending small amounts so Gmail, Outlook and other providers learn to trust it. If a domain ever wears out, we retire it and swap in a fresh one. Your real domain is never at risk.

      Short, Fast, Read in Minutes

      Text Sequences

      Texts get read quickly, so we use them where timing matters: a code that expires this week, or a reminder the day before your event. Each sequence is three short texts on a set schedule, and we track all of the activity.

        Postcards to Local Searchers

        For Partnerships, Not Shoppers

        Ringless Voicemail to Strategic Partners

        A recorded message from Erin drops straight into a business’s voicemail without the phone ringing. It’s the easiest way to open doors with hotels, wineries and planners who can send you customers again and again.

        B2B Strategic PartnershipsClick a Partner Type
        1. 1We Build the Partner List. Hotels, wineries and wedding planners in Sonoma, Marin, Napa and any other areas you want to target.
        2. 2We Write the Script Together. We work with you on a short, natural script for each partner type, so it sounds like you, not a sales pitch.
        3. 3Erin Records One Message per Partner Type. About 30 seconds, in her own voice.
        4. 4We Automate the Sending. It drops straight into their voicemail and the phone never rings. They see your name, your business and a transcript, and hear Erin’s voice.
        5. 5We Follow Up. A follow up email goes out the same day, and everyone we’ve contacted shows up in your dashboard.
        6. 6Your Team Closes the Loop. If a partner doesn’t respond, your team can call them back to set up a meeting, one to one.

        About the Audio: This Is a Sample Computer VoiceSo it won’t sound natural. Press play on the phone to hear the script. The real message is recorded in Erin’s own voice, so it sounds like her, and when partners call back and talk with her, they hear the same voice.
